name: fairshare-frontend
//: Angular packages are pinned to one exact version rather than a caret range. From 18.2.10 onwards @angular/compiler-cli requires chokidar 4 while @angular-devkit/core still requires chokidar 3, which leaves npm unable to produce a lock file that `npm ci` will accept. Pinning the set to a version line whose transitive dependencies agree fixes it properly, without an override that would force one of them onto a major version it was not built against.
